pages.en:
Thousands Of Bags Of
Cheap Flour Sold Over
City To Poor Chinese

Loafers Taking Advantage Of Situation, Fighting
Way Into Lines And Then Selling Flour
At Premium; Police Have Busy Time

206 NOODLE SHOPS FORCED TO CLOSE
DOORS DUE TO HIGH FLOUR COSTS

From dawn yesterday tens of thousands of poor Chinese gathered outside certain rice and flour shops in the Settlement and the French Concession, awaiting for the shops to open at 9 a.m. so that they could each obtain a bag of flour at the special cheap price of $10.30.

The crowds in most cases were so large that special squads of police had to be rushed to each shop to keep them in order and also to protect the stores and prevent riots. In the West Hongkew district, on North Chekiang Road near Tiendong Road, the crowd of several thousand became unruly and the Reserve Unit had to be called out at about 10.27 a.m. to help maintain order. A minor riot also occurred on Peking Road near Shanse Road.

This system of selling cheap flour to the public will continue daily, it was announced on Saturday, for a period of a whole month until March 18. The 17 shops in the International Settlement and the 10 in the Concession will continue the sales of the flour daily from 9 o'clock in the morning until noon and again from 1.30 p.m., if the daily stocks permit.

A rush for the cheap flour was anticipated yesterday but not half as large as actually materialized. An inkling of what actually would take place was seen shortly after 6.30 a.m when the sidewalks and the roads outside each concerned shop were so crowded that traffic could hardly move. Police officers in charge of the various districts immediately detailed extra men to keep the crowds under control.

Barbed wire barricades were brought out from police stations and, together with thick ropes and P.W.D trestles, were used to keep the waiting crowds in check locally. By the time the shops opened at 9 a.m some sort of order was achieved by the police and, in most cases the purchasers moved up to the stores in an orderly manner.

**Loafers' Racket**

In some cases, those who arrived at dawn only got a chance to purchase their bag of flour just before the shops closed at noon while others even had to wait until the shops reopened afterwards. While the sale was going on in each shop, at regular intervals trucks drove up and brought fresh supplies of flour direct from the mills. It was estimated that about 2,000 bags of flour were sold by each shop yesterday.

As is always the case, a large proportion of the purchasers of the flour yesterday were loafers and other petty racketeers, who no sooner had they carried off their bag a block or two from the scene of the purchase than they commenced looking for likely purchasers and would sell the bag for as much as $11.50 and in some cases for $13, thus making a profit of $1.20 to $2.80 for having stood in line. The loafer would then rush back immediately and try to force his way as quickly as possible through the waiting crowd.

**Minor Riot**

A minor riot occurred this morning outside a rice shop on Peking Road, near Shanse Road. Here a crowd of loafers, taking advantage of the situation, attempted to push their way into the waiting line for a second time, right after having obtained one bag of flour. The crowd objected and a fight started, police finally managing to smooth the situation out.

Men, women and children were seen throughout the day yesterday marching or resting along Settlement and Concession streets with a bag of flour slung over their shoulder. The crowds had not diminished late in the afternoon, but rather increased as the news spread that cheap flour was being sold. Crowds were augmented by Chinese who came in from Nantao, Chapei, and even across from Pootung to obtain cheap flour.

**Noodle Shops Close**

Over 200 Chinese raw noodle (Cheih mien) shops in the Settlement and the Concession were forced to close their doors yesterday as the direct result of the abnormally high price of flour. An urgent appeal was sent by them to the Chinese Chamber of Commerce requesting relief.

In their appeal the noodle shop proprietors requested the Chamber of Commerce to petition the two municipal authorities to impose a price limit of $10 a bag of flour and also to negotiate with the large flour mills for direct supply of flour to them at wholesale prices.
pages.zh:
成千上万袋廉价面粉
在全市向贫困华人出售

游手好闲者利用局势，强行挤入排队队伍，随后以高价转售面粉；警方忙碌不堪

206家面馆因面粉成本高昂被迫关门

昨日黎明时分，数以万计的贫困华人聚集在公共租界和法租界的某些米店和面粉店外，等待店铺于上午9点开门，以便每人能以10.30元的特别低价购买一袋面粉。

在大多数情况下，人群规模如此之大，以至于不得不向每家店铺紧急增派特别警察小队，以维持秩序，保护商店并防止骚乱。在虹口西区，靠近天潼路的北浙江路（North Chekiang Road），数千人的 crowd 变得难以控制，后备队（Reserve Unit）不得不在上午10点27分左右出动协助维持秩序。在山西路（Shanse Road）附近的北京路也发生了一起小规模骚乱。

上周六宣布，这种向公众出售廉价面粉的制度将持续整整一个月，直至3月18日。公共租界内的17家店铺和法租界内的10家店铺将继续每日从上午9点至中午，以及下午1点30分开始（若当日库存允许）出售面粉。

昨日预计会出现抢购廉价面粉的热潮，但实际规模远超预期，甚至不止一倍。清晨6点30分过后不久，相关店铺外的人行道和道路上拥挤不堪，交通几乎停滞，这让人对即将发生的状况有了初步了解。负责各区域的警官立即抽调额外人手来控制人群。

从警察局运出了铁丝网路障，并与粗绳和工务处（P.W.D.）的支架一起使用，在当地约束等待的人群。到上午9点店铺开门时，警方已建立起某种秩序，在大多数情况下，购买者有序地走向商店。

**游手好闲者的勾当**

在某些情况下，那些黎明时分就到达的人直到中午店铺关门前才刚刚有机会购买他们的一袋面粉，而其他人甚至不得不等到之后店铺重新开门。在每家店铺进行销售期间，卡车每隔一段时间就会驶来，直接从磨坊运来新鲜的面粉供应。据估计，昨日每家店铺售出了约2,000袋面粉。

与往常一样，昨日购买面粉的人中有很大一部分是游手好闲者和其他小混混，他们刚把买到的一袋面粉带离购买地点一两个街区，就开始寻找可能的买家，并将这袋面粉以高达11.50元的价格出售，在某些情况下甚至卖到13元，从而通过排队获利1.20元至2.80元。随后，这些游手好闲者会立即冲回，试图尽快强行穿过等待的人群。

**小规模骚乱**

今天上午，在山西路附近的北京路一家米店外发生了一起小规模骚乱。在这里，一群游手好闲者利用局势，在刚买到一袋面粉后，试图再次强行挤入等待的队伍。人群表示反对，引发了斗殴，警方最终设法平息了事态。

昨日全天，可以看到男人、女人和儿童肩上扛着一袋面粉，在租界和法租界的街道上行走或休息。傍晚时分，人群并未减少，反而随着廉价面粉出售消息的传播而增加。来自南市、闸北，甚至从浦东过来的华人也加入人群，以获取廉价面粉。

**面馆关门**

由于面粉价格异常高涨，公共租界和法租界内超过200家中式生面（Cheih mien）馆昨日被迫关门。他们向上海总商会发出紧急呼吁，请求救济。

在他们的呼吁中，面馆业主请求总商会向两个市政当局请愿，将每袋面粉的价格限制在10元，并与大型面粉厂谈判，以便以批发价格直接向它们供应面粉。

pages.en:
Populace Buys
Cheaper Flour

No Serious Disturbances
Reported As 7,500 Bags
Were Placed on Sale

With Settlement and Concession police in attendance at the 27 specially designated flour hongs in this city, the populace bought 7,500 bags of flour containing 49 lb. each at the low price of $10.30 per bag yesterday. No disorders of any importance occurred as constables were on the look-out to keep the crowds of buyers in check. In West Hongkew district, the Reserve Unit which was on routine duty there, helped the station police to keep order at the Zuay Kee Hong, 122 North Chekiang Road, where the biggest crowd in the Settlement had gathered by 9 a.m. No untoward incident occurred and many of the hongs were sold out well before the evening.

This cheap flour was placed on sale commencing yesterday following negotiations between the Settlement and Concession authorities and flour merchants, when it was decided that 7,500 bags should be disposed of daily by specially designated shops in both foreign areas in order to ease the serious food-price situation.

This low-priced flour which is being made available through the co-operation of the Fou Foong and the Fu Hsing Flour Mills, comes as a boon at the present time when all staple food prices are soaring. As an indication, it may be added that Chinese flour yesterday sold at $13 and imported flour at about $25 per bag.

Meanwhile, negotiations are proceeding between Mr. Yu Ya Ching, other prominent civic leaders and coal merchants with a view to distributing coal balls—a combustible required for cooking in every Chinese household—at a price lower than $5.80 per picul which is effective in all shops as from today. In this connection, it is recalled that until yesterday, coal balls were sold at between $7 and $8 per picul as compared to $1 and less, effective before the outbreak of hostilities in Shanghai in 1937.

The police, on the other hand, are keeping a close check on the maintenance of rice prices and a shop owner and a dealer were prosecuted by the S.M.P. in the First Special District Court yesterday morning, for having exceeded the highest prices permissible They were sentenced to serve a term of imprisonment of 15 days each.

Additional conferences, it is understood, are being held with a view to further reducing existing commodity prices which are causing havoc with the budgets of the Chinese population, and it is expected that further reductions may be expected in the prices of coal and possibly Saigon rice.

Commencing with Friday, 2,000 bags of "broken" Saigon Rice will be placed on sale in designated rice hongs at a special low price although purchasers will only be permitted to buy $1 worth at one time.
pages.zh:
民众购买
廉价面粉

未报告发生严重骚乱
7,500袋面粉投放市场

昨日，在租界及法租界警方的监视下，市民在本市27家特别指定的面粉行以每袋10.30元的低价购买了7,500袋面粉，每袋重49磅。由于巡捕时刻警惕，控制着购货人群，未发生任何重大混乱。在虹口西区，正在该处执行日常任务的后备队协助分站警察在北浙江路122号的“聚记行”（Zuay Kee Hong）维持秩序，至上午9时，此处聚集了租界内最大的人群。未发生意外事件，许多面粉行在傍晚之前便已售罄。

此次廉价面粉自昨日起开始发售，这是租界及法租界当局与面粉商人谈判的结果，双方决定由两个外国区域内的特别指定商店每日售出7,500袋，以缓解严重的食品价格局势。

这种低价面粉是通过福丰（Fou Foong）和复兴（Fu Hsing）面粉厂的协作提供的，在当前所有主食价格飙升之际，此举可谓雪中送炭。作为参照，值得一提的是，昨日国产面粉售价为每袋13元，进口面粉约为每袋25元。

与此同时，虞洽卿先生及其他知名社会领袖正与煤炭商人进行谈判，旨在以低于每担5.80元的价格分发煤球——这是每个中国家庭烹饪所需的燃料——该价格自今日起在所有商店生效。在此方面，需指出的是，直至昨日，煤球的售价仍在每担7至8元之间，而1937年上海战事爆发前的有效价格则为1元及以下。

另一方面，警方正严密监控大米价格的维持情况。昨日上午，一名店主和一名经销商因超出最高允许价格，被上海公共租界工部局警务处在第一特区法院起诉。两人均被判处监禁15天。

据悉，为进一步降低目前严重扰乱中国民众预算的现有商品价格，正在召开额外会议，预计煤炭价格以及可能的西贡大米价格将进一步下调。

自周五起，2,000袋“碎”西贡米将以特别低价在指定的米行发售，尽管每位购买者一次仅允许购买价值1元的大米。

Misc. No. 68/40
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
West Hongkew Station,
REPORT
Date Feb 19, D. 1940.
Subject Sale of flour at a cheap rate in West Hongkew District.
Made by D. S. Bevan Forwarded by Inspector,
Officer i/c
Sir,
With reference to the sale of flour at a cheap rate
in West Hongkew District the following is a list of
designated centres and number of bags scheduled for sale
on the 19-2-40.
Zai Kyi Flour Shop, No. 122 North Chekiang Road -
1,700 bags. Shun Yu Flour Shop, No. 751 Tiendong Road
- 600 bags.
Dah Foon Rice Shop, No. 733 Boone Road - 50 bags.
Tung Foon Flour Shop, No. 20 Purdon Road - 550 bags.
As a result of observation kept at these places the
following is submitted:-
In the instance of the Zai Kyi Flour Shop, No. 122
North Chekiang Road listed for the sale of 1,700 bags of
flour on the 19-2-40, the proprietor Tseu Sih Kyih
( ) received instructions from Mr. T.K. Ho,
Assistant Secretary of the ... to sell a double
quota, 3,400 bags, in view of the fact that no sale had
been conducted on Sunday, 18-2-40.
Whereas sale was scheduled to begin at 9 a.m. the
first consignment of flour did not arrive until 8.30
a.m. and that of the last was 11.30 a.m.
Preparation was made by the Station to cope with
would be purchasers and details took up positions at
5 a.m. However a large number of persons had already
put in appearance as early as 4.30 a.m.
Failure to commence sales at the advertised time of
9 a.m. caused the crowd which had assumed huge proportions
to become restless.

杂项第 68/40 号
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
虹口西区巡捕房，
报告
日期：1940 年 2 月 19 日。
事由：虹口西区廉价面粉销售情况。
呈报人：D. S. Bevan（警司）
转发人：督察长

先生：

关于虹口西区廉价面粉销售一事，现将指定销售点及定于 1940 年 2 月 19 日销售的面粉袋数列表如下：

浙江北路 122 号再记面粉店——1,700 袋。
天潼路 751 号顺裕面粉店——600 袋。
蓬路 733 号大丰米店——50 袋。
蒲登路 20 号同丰面粉店——550 袋。

经对上述地点进行监视观察，现提交报告如下：

就浙江北路 122 号再记面粉店而言，该店原定于 1940 年 2 月 19 日销售 1,700 袋面粉，店主周世奇（Tseu Sih Kyih，音译）接到……助理秘书何德奎（T.K. Ho，音译）先生的指示，鉴于 1940 年 2 月 18 日（星期日）未进行销售，故将配额加倍至 3,400 袋。

虽然销售预定于上午 9 时开始，但第一批面粉直至上午 8 时 30 分才运抵，最后一批则于上午 11 时 30 分到达。

巡捕房为应对预期前来购买的民众做了准备，警员于上午 5 时到位部署。然而，早在上午 4 时 30 分，已有大量人员出现。

未能按公告的上午 9 时开始销售，导致规模庞大的 crowd（人群）变得焦躁不安。

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
West Hongkew Station,
REPORT
Date February 19, 1940.
Subject. (2)
Made by. Forwarded by

The D.C. Divisions on visiting the scene ordered the
R.U. (M) to attend, which they did at 10.27a.m. The crowd at
this time had exceeded 8,000 and before any semblance of order
had been restored extensive damage had been done to plate glass
and shutters of the following shops:-
Lou Ching Yue Medicine Shop, 94 North Chekiang Road.
Plate glass window and shutters smashed.
The Bah Mei Kwei Barber Shop, 886 Tientong Road.
Shutters and four panes of glass smashed.
The Sing Sung Fah Barber Shop, No. 12 Fuchen Road.
Front shop windows smashed.
Numerous cases of fainting and crushing occurred but
no injuries of a serious nature were reported.
Sales were concluded at 12.30p.m. following which a
large staff of police were still necessary to keep would-be
purchasers moving.
Equal difficulties were experienced at other centres.
At the Shun Yi Flour Shop, No. 751 Tientong Road, the crowd,
about 4,000 in number refused to disperse when informed that
the supply of flour had been exhausted, commenced throwing
stones and gravel from nearby road repairs. They were eventually
dispersed by the Reserve Unit, no arrest being made.
This distribution of cheap flour being principally for
the poorer classes, there is a notable presence of the better
class and a still larger proportion of the loafer element. The
latter it was ascertained purchase the flour for $10.30 per bag
and resell it for as high as $13.00, which tends to minimise the
aid intended. There appears to be no doubt that this class of
person is responsible for the disorder at the various shops.
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号。
西虹口巡捕房，
报告
日期：1940年2月19日。
事由。(2)
制作人。转发人

各区副总监视察现场后，命令机动队（M队）到场，该队于上午10时27分抵达。此时人群已超过8,000人，在秩序稍有恢复之前，下列店铺的平板玻璃和百叶窗已遭受严重损坏：-
陆庆余药店，浙江北路94号。
平板玻璃窗和百叶窗被砸碎。
巴美贵理发店，天潼路886号。
百叶窗和四块玻璃被砸碎。
新胜发理发店，福辰路12号。
店面橱窗被砸碎。
发生多起晕厥和挤压事件，但未报告有严重性质的伤害。
销售于下午12时30分结束，此后仍需大量警力维持秩序，促使欲购者离开。
其他分发点也遇到同样的困难。
在天潼路751号的顺益面粉店，约4,000人的 crowd 在被告知面粉供应耗尽后拒绝散去，并开始从附近道路维修处投掷石块和碎石。他们最终被后备队驱散，无人被捕。
此次廉价面粉的分发主要面向贫困阶层，但现场却有显著数量的上层阶级人士，以及更大比例的游手好闲之徒。经查实，后者以每袋10.30元的价格购买面粉，并以高达13.00元的价格转售，这使得预期的援助效果大打折扣。毫无疑问，正是这类人导致了各店铺发生的骚乱。

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No
West Hongkew Station,
REPORT
Date February 19, 1940.
Subject (3)
Made by Forwarded by

The present system of distributing as little as 50 bags
to some centres is out of all proportion when the benefit
afforded is compared with the large force of police necessary
to control the sale.

Irregularity of deliveries:-
At the present the flour is delivered at times when
the crowds of would-be purchasers are largest.

Arrangements are being made with the proprietors by the
Officer in charge to effect deliveries at the centres in the
late afternoon. Police protection will be afforded until the
following day unless the Flour Mills could be prevailed upon to
co-operate and permit the following day's supply to be delivered
during the hours of curfew.

D.C. (Divisions), D.O. "C" and A.C. (A. T. R.) attended.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

D.S. 61.

D.D.O. "C".

目前向某些配给点仅分发50袋面粉的制度，若将此举带来的益处与管控销售所需的大量警力相比，实在极不相称。

送货时间不规律：
目前，面粉往往在求购人群最为拥挤的时段送达。

负责警官正与各业主协商，安排于傍晚时分向各配给点送货。除非能说服面粉厂予以配合，允许在宵禁期间运送次日的面粉供应，否则警方将提供保护直至次日。

分区副巡官（各分区）、“C”区巡官及助理总监（特别调查科）均已出席。

此致
阁下

您顺从的仆人，

D.S. 61.

“C”区副巡官。

West Hongkew Station,
Feb. 19, 1940.

Sale of flour at a cheap rate in West Hongkew
District.
--------------------------------------------------

With reference to the sale of flour at a cheap rate
in West Hongkew District the following is a list of
designated centres and number of bags scheduled for sale
on the 19-2-40.

Zai Kyi Flour Shop, No. 122 North Chekiang Road -
1,700 bags. Shun Yu Flour Shop, No. 751 Tienderg Road
- 600 bags.

Dal Foong Rice Shop, No. 733 Boone Road - 50 bags.
Tung Po ng Flour Shop, No. 20 Purdon Road - 550 bags.

As a result of observation kept at these places the
following is submitted:-

In the instance of the Zai Kyi Flour Shop, No. 122
North Chekiang Road listed for the sale of 1,700 bags of
flour on the 19-2-40, the proprietor Pen Sih Kyih
(潘瑞記) received instructions from Mr. T.K. Ho,
Deputy Secretary of the S.M.C. to sell a double
quota, 3,400 bags, in view of the fact that no sale had
been conducted on Sunday, 18-2-40.

Whereas sale was scheduled to begin at 9 a.m. the
first consignment of flour did not arrive until 8.30
a.m. and that of the last was 11.30 a.m.

Preparation was made by the Station to cope with
would be purchasers and details took up positions at
5 a.m. However a large number of persons had already
put in appearance as early as 4.30 a.m.

Failure to commence sales at the advertised time of
9 a.m. caused the crowd which had assumed huge proportions
to become restless.
pages.zh:
虹口西区警署，
1940年2月19日。

虹口区廉价面粉销售情况。
--------------------------------------------------

关于虹口区廉价面粉销售一事，现将1940年2月19日指定的销售点及计划销售的面粉袋数列表如下：

浙江北路122号再记面粉店——1,700袋。天潼路751号顺裕面粉店——600袋。

博恩路733号达丰米店——50袋。蒲登路20号同宝面粉店——550袋。

经在上述地点观察，现提交报告如下：

就浙江北路122号再记面粉店而言，该店原定于1940年2月19日销售1,700袋面粉，但店主潘瑞记（音译）接到工部局副秘书何德奎（T.K. Ho，音译）先生的指示，鉴于1940年2月18日（星期日）未进行销售，故将销售量加倍至3,400袋。

虽然销售预定于上午9时开始，但第一批面粉直至上午8时30分才运抵，最后一批则于上午11时30分到达。

警署为应对预期前来购买的民众做了准备，警员于凌晨5时到位部署。然而，早在凌晨4时30分，已有大量人员出现。

未能按广告公布的上午9时开始销售，导致规模庞大的 crowd 变得焦躁不安。

pages.en:
- 2 -

The D.C. Divisions on visiting the scene ordered the
R.U. (W) to attend, which they did at 10.27a.m. The crowd at
this time had exceeded 8,000 and before any semblance of order
had been restored extensive damage had been done to plate
glass and shutters of the following shops:-
    Lou Ching Yue Medicine Shop, 94 North Chekiang Road.
Plate glass window and shutters smashed.
    The Bah Mei Kwei Barber Shop, 866 Tiendong Road.
Shutters and four panes of glass smashed.
    The Sing Sung Fah Barber Shop, No.12 Purdon Road.
Front shop windows smashed.
    Numerous cases of fainting and crushing occurred but
no injuries of a serious nature were reported.
    Sales were concluded at 12.30p.m. following which a
large staff of police were still necessary to keep would-be
purchasers moving.
    Equal difficulties were experienced at other centres.
At the Shun Yu Flour Shop, No.751 Tiendong Road, the crowd,
about 4,000 in number refused to disperse when informed that
the supply of flour had been exhausted, commenced throwing
stones and gravel from nearby road repairs. They were
eventually dispersed by the Reserve Unit, no arrest being
made.
    This distribution of cheap flour being principally for
the poorer classes, there is a notable presence of the better
class and a still larger proportion of the loafer element.
The latter it was ascertained purchase the flour for $10.30
per bag and resell it for as high as $13.00, which tends to
minimise the aid intended. There appears to be no doubt
that this class of person is responsible for the disorder
at the various shops.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

副总巡（D.C.）各分区警司抵达现场后，命令西区后备队（R.U. (W)）前往支援，该队于上午10时27分到达。此时人群已超过8,000人，在秩序稍有恢复之前，下列商铺的平板玻璃和百叶窗已遭受严重损坏：

    陆庆余药店，浙江北路94号。
    平板玻璃窗和百叶窗被砸碎。

    巴美贵理发店，天潼路866号。
    百叶窗和四块玻璃被砸碎。

    新胜发理发店，浦登路12号。
    店面橱窗被砸碎。

    发生多起晕厥和挤压事件，但未报告有严重性质的伤害。

    销售于下午12时30分结束，此后仍需大量警力维持秩序，以推动有意购买者离开。

    其他分发点也遇到了同样的困难。在天潼路751号的顺裕面粉店，约4,000名群众在被告知面粉已售罄后拒绝散去，并开始从附近道路维修处投掷石块和碎石。他们最终被后备队驱散，未实施逮捕。

    此次廉价面粉的分发主要面向贫困阶层，但现场却有显著数量的上层阶级人士，以及更大比例的游手好闲之徒。经查实，后者以每袋10.30美元的价格购入面粉，并以高达13.00美元的价格转售，这使得旨在提供的援助效果大打折扣。毫无疑问，正是这类人引发了各家店铺的骚乱。

pages.en:
- 3 -

The present system of distributing as little as 50 bags
to some centres is out of all proportion when the benefit
afforded is compared with the large force of police necessary
to control its sale.

Irregularity of deliveries:-

As the present the flour is delivered at times when
the crowds of would-be purchasers are largest.

Arrangements are being made with the proprietors by the
Officer in charge to effect deliveries at the centres in the
late afternoon. Police protection will be afforded until the
following day unless the Flour Mills could be prevailed upon to
co-operate and permit the following day's supply to be delivered
during the hours of curfew.

Certified true copy.

CLK/
pages.zh:
- 3 -

目前向某些配给点仅分发50袋面粉的制度，若将所获效益与控制其销售所需的大量警力相比，显然极不相称。

交货时间不规律：

目前，面粉往往在求购人群最为拥挤的时段送达。

负责警官正与各业主作出安排，以便在傍晚时分将面粉运抵各配给点。除非能说服面粉厂予以配合，允许在宵禁期间运送次日的面粉供应，否则警方将提供保护直至次日。

经核证为真实副本。

CLK/

Sir,

The conditions as regards the sale of cheap flour
remained unchanged throughout 21.2.1940.

The four distributing centres at 122 North Chekiang
Road, 751 Tientsing Road, and 733 Boone Road
and 50 Purdon Road received and
sold 1700, 600, 550 bags of flour respectively and all
sales were concluded by 10.45.a.m.

No untoward incidents occurred but at North Chekiang
Road it was found that certain persons were exploiting the
sales and ten male Chinese were arrested when found attempt-
ing to re-sell the flour at prices ranging from $11.50
to $13.00 per bag. These men were questioned by station
and Special Branch detectives and the matter was subseq-
uently laid before the Legal Dept. from whom it was ascert-
ained that no action could be taken beyond charging those
concerned with obstruction. The matter was later laid
before the D.I.O."C" Division who authorised the release
of the parties concerned. It being obvious that these
persons had no immediate use for the flour same was taken
from them and their money refunded. They were cautioned
against a repetition of the offence and were subsequently
released.

Contrary to previous reports the premises at No.63
Boundary Road did not commence sales and will not now be
used as a distribution centre. As from date the sale of
flour

at the daily allowance will be distributed direct to
noodle, macaroni and wheatcake shops in a further effort

事由：廉价面粉销售情况。

呈报人：D. I. F.O.Guess（音译）。经由督察转呈，
负责警官。

敬启者，

1940年2月21日全天，廉价面粉的销售状况保持不变。

位于浙江北路122号、天津路751号、布恩路733号以及珀登路50号的四个分销中心，分别接收并售出面粉1700袋、600袋、550袋（注：原文此处仅列出三个数字对应四个地点，依原文翻译），所有销售均于上午10时45分结束。

未发生任何意外事件，但在浙江北路发现有人利用销售之机牟利，十名中国男子在试图以每袋11.50元至13.00元的价格转售面粉时被逮捕。这些人员接受了警署及特别支部侦探的讯问，随后此事被提交至法律科，据该科告知，除指控相关人员妨碍公务外，无法采取其他行动。此事后来被提交至“C”区副督察长，其授权释放有关当事人。鉴于显然这些人并不急需使用这些面粉，面粉被从他们手中没收，钱款予以退还。对他们进行了警告，不得再犯，随后将其释放。

与之前的报告相反，界路63号的场所并未开始销售，今后也不会用作分销中心。自即日起，浙江北路122号的面粉销售也将停止，每日配给量将直接分配给面条、通心粉和麦饼店，以进一步努力

（左侧手写批注：）
R.W.

Subject Sales of cheap flour.

Made by and Forwarded by Inspector S.V. Gash.

Sir,

Further to my report on the above subject dated
February 17 and Miscellaneous Report 68/40, no untoward
incident occurred during the day at any of the four shops
designated to sell bags of flour at a cheap rate.

At No. 122 North Chekiang Road and 751 Tiendong Road
stocks of 1,700 bags and 600 bags respectively were exhausted
by 9.20a.m. at the former and 11a.m. at the latter shop. The
delay at Tiendong Road was caused by the non-arrival of
supplies from the mill. This has been remedied at each shop,
as from today stocks for the following day's supply will be
delivered during the late afternoon under Police protection
and a guard posted at each address.

As was observed on the previous day, the demand at
each shop was greatly in access of the supply and at 122
North Chekiang Road the Police had considerable difficulty
again in controlling the crowd, a large number of which
congregated at the shop before 4a.m. Lt. Farquhar, 1st Batt.
Seaforth Highlanders, O/C "B" Sector commanding a small patrol
assisted the Police in an unofficial capacity at this shop
between 6a.m. and 8.30a.m. pending the arrival of reinforce-
ments from the Reserve Unit at 9a.m.

Mr. H.D.M. Robertson visited the scene during the
progress of the sale and after conveying his observation to
the D.C. (Divisions) it was decided that from a Police view-
point sales could no longer be permitted at 122 North Chekiang
Road and that it was imperative that this selling centre should
be established in a less congested part of the district. Sui-
table premises formerly operated as the Ho Kee Tea Hong wer

由警司 S.V. Gash 撰写并呈报。

阁下：

继我于2月17日就上述事由提交的报告及第68/40号杂项报告之后，在指定以低价出售袋装面粉的四家店铺中，当日均未发生任何意外事件。

位于北浙江路122号和天潼路751号的店铺，其库存分别为1,700袋和600袋，前者于上午9时20分售罄，后者于上午11时售罄。天潼路店铺的延误系因面粉厂供货未到所致。此情况已在各店得到纠正，自今日起，次日供应的库存将于下午晚些时候在警方护卫下送达，并在各地址部署警卫。

正如前一日所观察到的那样，各店的需求量远远超过供应量，在北浙江路122号，警方再次难以控制人群，其中有大量人员在凌晨4点前便聚集在该店。苏格兰高地团第一营法夸尔（Farquhar）中尉，“B”防区指挥官，率领一支小型巡逻队，在上午6时至8时30分之间以非官方身份协助该店的警务工作，直至上午9时预备队增援到达。

H.D.M. 罗伯逊（Robertson）先生在销售进行期间视察了现场，并向分区副巡官（D.C. (Divisions)）转达了他的观察意见，随后决定，从警务角度来看，不再允许在北浙江路122号进行销售，且必须将该销售点设在本区较为不拥挤的地段。原作为和记茶行（Ho Kee Tea Hong）经营的合适场所

Subject Class of people attending sales of cheap flour.
Made by D. S. Henchman. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

Enquiries, independent from those made by stations, concerning the class of people attending the present sales of cheap flour tend to show that apart from loafers and other persons not purchasing on their own behalf, buyers, for the greater part, are the proprietors of wheat-cake and noodle shops. The remainder are persons from the Western District, Chapei and Pootung, with a very small sprinkling of the class for whose benefit the sale of cheap flour was instituted, i.e. the poorer residents of the Settlement.

February 17, 1940
Date

Commissioner of Police.

Sales of cheap flour

At 2.15 p.m. 16/2/40, a meeting convened
by Mr. T.K. Ho, Deputy Secretary, was held in the
Council Chamber and attended by Mr. Ho, his staff,
representatives of the French and Municipal Police
Forces and about 40 Chinese dealers and shop-keepers.

Mr. Ho explained the extreme necessity of
keeping prices at a minimum and measures to amelior-
ate present conditions in re: flour were discussed.
The following points were agreed upon:-

The management of the Foh Sing and Fou
Foong Flour Mills agreed to supply 7,500 bags of
flour daily for sale and consumption solely in Shanghai.
The Foh Sing Mill will supply 2,500 bags and the Fou
Foong 5,000 bags daily. The price ex-mill will be
$10 per bag effective from February 18; this price
will remain fixed for a period of one month when the
managements of the mills will review and reconsider
their prices.

All wholesale and retail dealers have in
turn agreed to sell this flour at $10.30 per bag and
to do their utmost to ensure that no person purchases
more than one bag per day. Sales on the lines enumer-
ated above will commence on Monday February 19 in 17
(including 3 on O.O.L. roads) shops situated in the
Settlement and 10 shops situated in the Concession
as per lists attached herewith.

Shops will open for business daily at 9 a.m.
and continue until 12 noon. If stocks are not then
exhausted, sales will continue in the afternoon, com-
mencing from 1.30 p.m. until stocks are exhausted.

1940年2月17日
日期

警务总监。

廉价面粉销售事宜

1940年2月16日下午2时15分，由副秘书何德奎（T.K. Ho）先生召集的会议在工部局议事厅举行。出席会议者包括何先生及其职员、法租界巡捕房与公共租界工部局警务处的代表，以及约40名中国商贩和店主。

何先生解释了将价格维持在最低水平的极端必要性，并讨论了改善当前面粉状况的措施。达成如下共识：

福新面粉厂（Foh Sing Flour Mills）与阜丰面粉厂（Fou Foong Flour Mills）的管理层同意每日供应7,500袋面粉，专供上海地区销售和消费。其中，福新面粉厂每日供应2,500袋，阜丰面粉厂每日供应5,000袋。自2月18日起，出厂价为每袋10元；此价格固定一个月，届时各厂管理层将对价格进行审查和重新考量。

所有批发和零售商贩依次同意以每袋10.30元的价格出售此面粉，并尽力确保每人每天购买不超过一袋。上述列举的销售方式将于2月19日（星期一）开始实施，涉及位于公共租界内的17家店铺（其中包括位于越界筑路区域的3家）以及位于法租界内的10家店铺，具体名单附后。

各店铺每日上午9时开门营业，持续至中午12时。若届时库存未售罄，下午将继续销售，从下午1时30分开始，直至库存售罄为止。

pages.en:
- 2 -

It is difficult to estimate the length of
time each shop will be engaged in the sale of this
cheap flour daily, but some idea can be gained from
the experiences of the past 4 or 5 days. A shop,
No. 122 N. Chekiang Road, has disposed of 1,000 bags
of flour daily in a period of 3 hours.

The shop-keepers and dealers requested
Police supervision during the hours of cheap sales
and Monsieur Moret and A.C. (Special Branch) agreed
to provide the necessary protection.

In addition to the protection afforded
the shops, I suggest that at the close of each day,
a responsible Police Officer visit each shop and
check and ensure that the supplies of flour delivered
have actually been sold. This precaution is necessary
to prevent hoarding and exportation. In order to
avoid misunderstanding and render the task of super-
vision of Police easier, no brand of flour other than
that produced by the Foh Sing and Fou Foong Mills
will be sold during the period February 19 - March 18
by the shops mentioned in the attached list.

A.C. (Special Branch)

JM
pages.zh:
- 2 -

难以估算每家店铺每日销售这种廉价面粉所需的时间长短，但可以从过去四五天的经验中略知一二。位于浙江北路122号的一家店铺，在3小时内售出了1,000袋面粉。

店主和经销商要求在廉价销售时段由警方进行监管，莫雷特先生（Monsieur Moret）与特别处助理处长（A.C.）同意提供必要的保护。

除了为店铺提供保护外，我建议每日结束时，由一名负责的警务官员走访每家店铺，检查并确保已交付的面粉供应确实已售出。采取这一预防措施对于防止囤积和出口是必要的。为了避免误解并使警方的监督工作更容易进行，在2月19日至3月18日期间，附件名单中所列店铺仅允许销售福新（Foh Sing）和阜丰（Fou Foong）面粉厂生产的面粉，不得销售其他品牌。

特别处助理处长（A.C.）

JM

February 17, 1940.

Commissioner of Police.

Sales of cheap flour

At 2.15 p.m. 16/2/40, a meeting convened
by Mr. T.Y. Ho, Deputy Secretary, was held in the
Council Chamber and attended by Mr. Ho, his staff,
representatives of the French and Municipal Police
Forces and about 40 Chinese dealers and shop-keepers.

Mr. Ho explained the extreme necessity of
keeping prices at a minimum and measures to ameliorate
present conditions in re: flour were discussed.
The following points were agreed upon:-

The management of the Foh Sing and Fou
Foong Flour Mills agreed to supply 7,500 bags of
flour daily for sale and consumption solely in Shanghai.
The Foh Sing Mill will supply 2,500 bags and the Fou
Foong 5,000 bags daily. The price ex-mill will be
$10 per bag effective from February 18; this price
will remain fixed for a period of one month when the
managements of the mills will review and reconsider
their prices.

All wholesale and retail dealers have in
turn agreed to sell this flour at $10.30 per bag and
to do their utmost to ensure that no person purchases
more than one bag per day. Sales on the lines enumerated
above will commence on Monday February 19 in 17
(including 3 on C.C.I. roads) shops situated in the
Settlement and 10 shops situated in the Concession
as per lists attached herewith.

Shops will open for business daily at 9 a.m.
and continue until 12 noon. If stocks are not then
exhausted, sales will continue in the afternoon,
commencing from 1.30 p.m. until stocks are exhausted.
pages.zh:
1940年2月17日。

警务处处长。

廉价面粉销售事宜

1940年2月16日下午2时15分，由副秘书长何德奎（T.Y. Ho）先生召集的会议在工部局议事厅举行。出席会议的有何德奎先生及其职员、法租界巡捕房与公共租界工部局警务处的代表，以及约40名中国商贩和店主。

何先生解释了将价格维持在最低水平的极端必要性，并讨论了改善当前面粉状况的措施。达成如下共识：

福新（Foh Sing）和阜丰（Fou Foong）面粉厂的管理层同意每日供应7,500袋面粉，专供上海地区销售和消费。其中，福新面粉厂每日供应2,500袋，阜丰面粉厂每日供应5,000袋。自2月18日起，出厂价为每袋10元；此价格固定一个月，届时各厂管理层将对价格进行审查和重新考量。

所有批发和零售商贩依次同意以每袋10.30元的价格出售此面粉，并尽力确保每人每天购买不超过一袋。上述销售方式将于2月19日（星期一）开始实施，涉及位于公共租界内的17家店铺（其中包括3家位于越界筑路区域的店铺）以及位于法租界内的10家店铺，具体名单附后。

各店铺每日上午9时开门营业，持续至中午12时。若届时库存未售罄，下午将继续销售，从下午1时30分开始，直至库存售完为止。

pages.en:
-2-
It is difficult to estimate the length of
time each shop will be engaged in the sale of this
cheap flour daily, but some idea can be gained from
the experiences of the past 4 or 5 days. A shop,
No. 122 N. Chekiang Road, has disposed of 1,000 bags
of flour daily in a period of 3 hours.
The shop-keepers and dealers requested
Police supervision during the hours of cheap sales
and Monsieur Moret and ... (Special Branch) agreed
to provide the necessary protection.
In addition to the protection afforded
the shops, I suggest that at the close of each day,
a responsible Police officer visit each shop and
check and ensure that the supplies of flour delivered
have actually been sold. This precaution is necessary
to prevent hoarding and exportation. In order to
avoid misunderstanding and render the task of super-
vision of Police easier, no brand of flour other than
that produced by the Foh Sing and Fou Foong Mills
will be sold during the period February 19 - March 18
by the shops mentioned in the attached list.

A. ... (Special Branch)
pages.zh:
-2-
难以估算每家店铺每日销售这种廉价面粉所需的时间长短，但可以从过去四五天的经验中略知一二。位于浙江北路122号的一家店铺，在3小时内售出了1,000袋面粉。

店主和经销商要求在廉价销售时段由警方进行监管，莫雷特先生（Monsieur Moret）及……（特别处）同意提供必要的保护。

除了为店铺提供保护外，我建议每天结束时，由一名负责的警务官员走访每家店铺，检查并确保已交付的面粉供应确实已售出。采取这一预防措施对于防止囤积和出口是必要的。为了避免误解并使警方的监督工作更容易进行，在2月19日至3月18日期间，附件名单中所列店铺除福新面粉厂和阜丰面粉厂生产的面粉外，不得出售其他任何品牌的面粉。

A. ……（特别处）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No
8030
S. B., Special Branch 11/66.
REPORT
Date Feb. 19, 1945.
Subject Cheap Sale of Flour - Notification published by
Chinese and Foreign Press
Made by D.S. Pharazyn Forwarded by J.I. Crawford

（批：For General D.S! 2/19）

Acting on instructions of P. A. to A. C.
(Special Branch), arrangements were made by the staff
of this Section with the managements of the local
foreign and Chinese Press for publication in their
respective papers of an article announcing the cheap
sale of flour between March 19 and April 18 by twenty-
seven stores (of which names and addresses were
attached in the Chinese Press) in the International
Settlement and French Concession.

In response, the North-China Daily News, the
Shanghai Times and the China Press as well as the Sin
Wan Pao, the Shun Pao, the Chinese-American Daily News,
the Ta Mei Pao, the National Herald, the Circulation
Daily News, the Central China Daily News, etc. published
on February 18 the article as requested, while a
similar article appeared in the Sin Shun Pao on
February 19.

A. C. (Special Branch).

（签名：J.I. Crawford）
D. S.
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号
8030
S. B.，特务科 11/66。
报告
日期：1945年2月19日。
主题：面粉廉价出售——中外语报刊发布的通告
呈报人：D.S. Pharazyn 转呈人：J.I. Crawford

（批注：致 D.S. 处长！2/19）

遵照警务处处长对助理警司（特务科）的指示，本科人员与本地中外报业管理层作出安排，在其各自报纸上刊登一篇文章，宣布位于公共租界和法租界的二十七家商店将于3月19日至4月18日期间廉价出售面粉（中文报刊附上了这些商店的名称和地址）。

作为回应，《字林西报》、《上海泰晤士报》和《大美晚报》以及《新闻报》、《申报》、《中美日报》、《大美人报》、《国民新闻报》、《循环日报》、《华中日报》等报刊于2月18日按要求刊登了该文章，而《新申报》则于2月19日刊登了类似文章。

助理警司（特务科）。

（签名：J.I. Crawford）
D. S.

pages.en:
Sale of Flour at Certain Shops.

Cheap sales of flour will take place daily between
9 a.m. and 12 noon at shops designated below. Each
customer will be allowed to purchase one bag of flour
and sales will continue daily until March 18th.

Purchasers must note that the sales are conducted
as a philanthropic undertaking intended to benefit the
people and they must observe strict order and not cause
any disturbance. Should unruly characters create any
trouble at these shops on any pretext whatsoever, they
will be instantly arrested and severely punished.

By order,
Commissioner of Police.

10
pages.zh:
指定店铺面粉销售事宜。

每日上午九时至中午十二时，将在下列指定店铺进行面粉廉价销售。每位顾客限购一袋面粉，销售活动将持续至三月十八日。

购买者须注意，此次销售系为造福民众之慈善举措，务必严守秩序，不得滋扰。若有不法之徒借故在上述店铺制造事端，将立即逮捕并从严惩处。

此令，
警务处处长。

Sir,
With reference to the sale of flour at a cheap rate at
the Zai Kee Flour Shop, 122 North Chekiang Road, the following
is respectfully submitted:-

The number of persons desirous of buying flour at the
above shop is increasing daily. On the morning of February 17,
it was estimated that a crowd of more than 3,000 congregated
at the shop desperately trying to make purchases. Most of them
had been waiting since 6a.m. A party of Police consisting of
6 Foreigners, 7 Sikhs and 12 Chinese reinforced by 8 details
from the Reserve Unit was necessary and these were frequently
overpowered and force had to be used to control the would-be
purchasers. One section of the crowd in Lane 114 became so
packed that the pressure resulted in the collapse of the South
wall which forms the rear of the Sung Fah Printing Shop, Lane
102 North Chekiang Road. The shutters of the Lou Ching Yue
Medicine Shop, 94 North Chekiang Road were forced in and the
plate glass window smashed. Six knife rests were also broken,
no serious injuries have so far been reported although there
were several cases of females fainting as the result of being
crushed in the crowd which consisted to a large extent of the
loafer element and at times assumed riotous proportions.

When the supply of flour was exhausted at 11a.m.,
upwards of 2,000 would-be purchasers still remained. Those
were dispersed with some difficulty but without untoward
incident.

From a Police point of view the position of this shop
for such a purpose is most unsuitable. It is situated in the
narrowest section of North Chekiang Road where with the

阁下：

关于浙江北路122号“再记”面粉店以廉价出售面粉一事，谨呈报如下：

欲在该店购买面粉的人数与日俱增。2月17日上午，据估计有超过3,000人聚集在该店，拼命试图购买。其中大多数人自早上6点起便一直等候。一支由6名外籍警员、7名锡克警员和12名华籍警员组成的警力，并得到后备队8个小分队的增援，才足以应对局面；即便如此，警方仍屡次被人群压倒，不得不动用武力来控制企图购买者。位于114弄的一部分人群拥挤不堪，导致压力过大，致使构成浙江北路102弄“松发印刷所”后墙的南墙倒塌。浙江北路94号“楼景岳”药店（音译）的百叶窗被强行挤入，平板玻璃窗被砸碎。另有六个刀架被损坏。截至目前，虽有多名女性因在人群中受挤压而昏厥，但尚未收到严重受伤的报告；该人群主要由游手好闲之徒组成，且有时呈现出骚乱的态势。

上午11时面粉售罄时，仍有2,000多名企图购买者滞留。这些人随后被驱散，过程虽有些困难，但未发生不幸事件。

从警务角度来看，该店的位置对于此类经营活动极不适宜。它位于浙江北路最狭窄的地段，随着

At 2.30 p.m. on 19th February 1940, a meeting convened by Mr. T. K. Ho, Deputy Secretary, was held in the Council Chamber and was attended by Mr. Ho, the Municipal Police represented by Mr. Yorke, Mr. Samson and Mr. Sharman, and the French Police represented by Mons. Moret and Mons. Emilianoff.

The local flour situation was discussed with particular reference to the sale of cheap flour which, in accordance with the agreement reached between the mill owners and the dealers, began in both Settlement and Concession on Monday, February 19th. The flour disposed of thus, it appeared, was not passing into the hands of that section of the public intended to benefit by the low rate at which it was offered but, instead, was being sold to loafers and agents who were, in turn, retailing it at excess profits.

Police representatives described the situation that existed at the flour shops in their respective districts and put forward suggestions which they considered might nullify the activities of profiteers and at the same time facilitate the handling of the large and, in some cases, disorderly crowds which had attended the shops in question.

Mr. Samson in whose district crowds had been largest and most unruly, said that amongst the

1940年2月19日下午2时30分，由副秘书何先生（Mr. T. K. Ho）召集的会议在工部局议事厅举行，出席会议的有何先生，代表警务处的约克先生（Mr. Yorke）、萨姆森先生（Mr. Samson）和夏曼先生（Mr. Sharman），以及代表法国警察局的莫雷先生（Mons. Moret）和埃米利亚诺夫先生（Mons. Emilianoff）。

会议讨论了本地面粉供应状况，特别关注廉价面粉的销售问题。根据面粉厂主与经销商达成的协议，此类面粉于2月19日（星期一）起在公共租界和法租界同时开始销售。据显示，以此方式处置的面粉并未流入旨在从低价中受益的那部分公众手中，反而被卖给了游手好闲之徒和代理商，这些人随后以超额利润进行零售。

警方代表描述了各自辖区内面粉店存在的情况，并提出了他们认为既能消除投机商活动，又能有助于应对涌入相关店铺的大批且有时混乱无序的人群的建议。

the poorer classes and that with this object in view
he had a proposal to put before the meeting. He said
that the small Chinese food shops, the macaroni,
wheat-cake and noodle establishments, catered to the masses
and, that being so, he was of the opinion that if
these shops could be provided with flour at a reasonable
rate, it would reduce the prices of their wares and
would thus do much to ameliorate conditions for the
poor. Enlarging on this theme, Mr. Ho stated that

在其能力范围内。
该提议获得了多数人的批准，但遭到何先生（Mr. Ho）的反对。何先生表示，他确信各面粉厂根本不可能考虑改用较小规格的面袋包装，因为面粉厂的机械仅适用于装填49磅重量的面袋，任何改动均不切实际。
在谈及有关某些面粉店人群行为失序的报告时，何先生表示，他认为这可能归咎于那些经销商；他们因近期决定低价出售面粉导致利润缩减而心生不满，企图破坏面粉厂管理层与零售商之间达成的协议。
何先生接着指出，安排低价面粉销售的目的是为了援助贫困阶层；基于这一目标，他拟向会议提出一项建议。他说，中式小食店、通心粉店、麦饼店及面馆面向大众提供服务，鉴于此，他认为若能以合理价格向这些店铺供应面粉，将降低其商品售价，从而大大改善穷人的处境。进一步阐述该观点时，何先生表示

that the food shops in question were licensed by
the S.M.C. and that the proprietors, as evidence
of their trade, should be made to produce their licences
at the time of buying flour. He went on to say that
a limit as regards the quantity to be purchased by
these shops, must be decided upon, but that this was
impossible until he had ascertained the number of
shops operating in both the Settlement and Concession.
After some discussion it was unanimously
agreed that Mr. Ho's proposal if put into execution,
would do something towards improving the lot of the
poor. It was further agreed that pending the
collection of the necessary statistics regarding
food shops, the sale of flour should be continued
in accordance with the original plan.

经讨论后，与会者一致同意，何先生（Mr. Ho）的提议若付诸实施，将有助于改善穷人的境遇。会议还决定，在收集有关食品店的必要统计数据期间，面粉销售仍按原计划继续进行。

(Headquarters) Office Notes
Date FEBRUARY 17, 1940
No. S. D. 1). & 178/ (2)

Commissioner of Police.

Sales of cheap flour

At 2.15 p.m. 16/2/40, a meeting convened
by Mr. T.K. Ho, Deputy Secretary, was held in the
Council Chamber and attended by Mr. Ho, his staff,
representatives of the French and Municipal Police
Forces and about 40 Chinese dealers and shop-keepers.
Mr. Ho explained the extreme necessity of
keeping prices at a minimum and measures to amelior-
ate present conditions in re: flour were discussed.
The following points were agreed upon:-
The management of the Foh Sing and Fou
Foong Flour Mills agreed to supply 7,500 bags of
flour daily for sale and consumption solely in Shanghai.
The Foh Sing Mill will supply 2,500 bags and the Fou
Foong 5,000 bags daily. The price ex-mill will be
$10 per bag effective from February 18; this price
will remain fixed for a period of one month when the
managements of the mills will review and reconsider
their prices.
All wholesale and retail dealers have in
turn agreed to sell this flour at $10.30 per bag and
to do their utmost to ensure that no person purchases
more than one bag per day. Sales on the lines enumer-
ated above will commence on Monday February 19 in 17
(including 3 on C.O.L. roads) shops situated in the
Settlement and 10 shops situated in the Concession
as per lists attached herewith.
Shops will open for business daily at 9 a.m.
and continue until 12 noon. If stocks are not then
exhausted, sales will continue in the afternoon, com-
mencing from 1.30 p.m. until stocks are exhausted.

（批：D.C. (2) (1)）
（印：17 FEB 1940 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

日期：1940年2月17日

致警务处处长。

廉价面粉销售事宜

1940年2月16日下午2时15分，由副秘书何德奎（T.K. Ho）先生召集的会议在工部局议事厅举行。出席会议者有何先生及其职员、法租界与公共租界警务当局的代表，以及约40名华商经销商和店主。何先生阐述了将价格维持在最低水平的极端必要性，并讨论了改善当前面粉状况的措施。
达成如下共识：
福新面粉厂与阜丰面粉厂的管理层同意每日供应7,500袋面粉，专供上海地区销售和消费。其中，福新面粉厂每日供应2,500袋，阜丰面粉厂每日供应5,000袋。出厂价为每袋10元，自2月18日起生效；该价格固定一个月，届时各厂管理层将对价格进行审查和重新考量。

It is difficult to estimate the length of
time each shop will be open in the sale of this
cheap flour daily, but some idea can be gained from
the experiences of the past 4 or 5 days. A shop,
No. 122 N. Cheniang Road, has disposed of 1,000 bags
of flour daily in a period of 3 hours.

The shop-keepers and dealers requested
Police supervision during the hours of cheap sales
and Monsieur Moret and A.C. (Special Branch) agreed
to provide the necessary protection.

In addition to the protection afforded
the shops, I suggest that at the close of each day,
a responsible Police Officer visit each shop and
check and ensure that the supplies of flour delivered
have actually been sold. This precaution is necessary
to prevent hoarding and exportation. In order to
avoid misunderstanding and render the task of super-
vision of Police easier, no brand of flour other than
that produced by the Foo Sin and Foo Soon Mills
will be sold during the period February 19 - March 18
by the shops mentioned in the attached list.

A.C. (Special Branch)

J.W.

特别处助理处长（A.C., Special Branch）

J.W.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.I., Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 8039A/S(3)
Stability 40
Date Jan. 29, 1940

Subject Zai Kee Flour Shop, 122 North Chekiang Road - sale
of flour at a cheaper rate.

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

瑞記
The Zai Kee Flour Shop, 122 North Chekiang
Road, has been selling flour at $10.30 per bag,
which is 50 cents to 70 cents cheaper than the price
quoted by other shops. Consequently a large number
of people have been making purchases from the shop
daily, the majority being Shantung cake shop owners.
On January 23, the number was so large
that police assistance was requested by the shop
master at 2.50 p.m. as shown in the attached copy
of C.C.R. messages.
The shop has conducted sales at a small
profit in order to benefit the public and will
continue to do so as long as supplies remain.
According to the shop, it is able to obtain a
supply of 1,000 bags from flour mills every day,
the present price quoted by the flour mills being
$10.00 per bag.

C. Crawford
D. I.

A.C. (Special Branch)

日期 1940年1月29日

事由 浙江北路122号瑞記面粉店——以较低价格出售面粉。

由督察克劳福德（Crawford）撰写并呈报

瑞記
位于浙江北路122号的瑞記面粉店一直以每袋10.30元的价格出售面粉，比其他店铺报价便宜50至70分。因此，每日有大量民众前往该店购买，其中大多数为山东饼店店主。
1月23日，由于人数众多，店主于下午2时50分请求警方协助，详情见附上的中央无线电收报机（C.C.R.）电文副本。
该店表示，其销售仅获微利，旨在惠及公众，只要货源充足，将继续维持此做法。
据该店称，其每日可从面粉厂获得1,000袋的供应，目前面粉厂报价为每袋10.00元。

C. 克劳福德
督察

For Information

With reference to the attached, enquiries
ascertain that because the Zai Kee Flour Shop,
122 North Chekiang Road, was selling flour at
$10.30 per bag as against $10.80 to $11.00 per bag
demanded by other shops, large number of persons
had applied to the shop to make purchases. By
2.30 p.m. January 23, the number of persons gathering
at the shop increased to several hundred, mostly
being Shantung cake shop people. At that time,
some females among them shouted owing to the crowded
conditions and consequently the police assistance
was solicited. There was no sign of attacking the
shop.

D c (Div)

来自BW。今日上午5时30分，四名男子雇用了一辆约翰逊牌汽车

人将车开走。已通知各岗哨拦截车牌号为16516的汽车。
（已通传）
（BW于同日早上8时45分注销该车牌）

上午9时06分。来自H。昨晚约8时，一名中国男子在汉伯里路（Hanbury Rd）附近的海伦路（Heian Rd）被三名男子拦劫，其中一人持仿制手
枪，企图抢走其身上的大衣和长衫。该男子见手枪为仿制品，便夺回大衣和长衫，双方随即发生打斗。随后劫匪掏出其钱包，倒出现款28.40美元，归还钱包后向不明方向逃窜。无人被捕。讲宁波话。（已通传）

下午1时55分。来自GR。今日下午约1时13分，配属GR巡捕房的华籍警员编号138，在康纳特路（Connaught Rd）附近的哈特路（Hart Rd）执勤时，被两名男子拦劫，其中一人持有武器，抢走其佩枪、子弹14发、委任证、电车月票等物品。未开枪。无人被捕。讲宁波话。（已通传）
